mapper.sql: SELECT tdm05_cncl_id AS cncl_id , tdm05_cncl_nm AS cncl_name , tdm05_open_cycle_cd AS open_cycle_code , f_cdnm('CycleCode', tdm05_open_cycle_cd, tdm05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS open_cycle_name , tdm05_main_decision AS main_decision , tdm05_start_date AS start_date , tdm05_end_date AS end_date , ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN '' ELSE COUNT(*)||'건' END FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm22_role_id WHERE tdm22_cncl_id = tdm05_cncl_id ) AS relate_role_cnt , tdm05_upd_nm AS upd_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm05_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS upd_date_str FROM tdm05_cncl
mapper.select:
WHERE tdm05_company_id = #{companyId}
AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm05_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm05_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd'))
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl WHERE tdm22_cncl_id = tdm05_cncl_id AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm22_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm22_end_date, DATE '2999-12-31') AND tdm22_role_id = #{roleId} )
ORDER BY tdm05_cncl_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", tdm05_open_cycle_cd, tdm05_start_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm22_role_id WHERE tdm22_cncl_id = #{cnclId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm05_cncl ( tdm05_cncl_id, tdm05_company_id, tdm05_cncl_nm, tdm05_open_cycle_cd, tdm05_main_decision, tdm05_start_date, tdm05_end_date, tdm05_upd_nm, tdm05_upd_date ) VALUES ( #{cnclId}, #{companyId}, #{row.cnclName}, #{row.openCycleCode}, #{row.mainDecision}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.endDate}, #{updName}, f_sysdate() )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id AS role_relate_cncl_id , tdm22_role_id AS role_id , tdm22_cncl_id AS cncl_id , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm22_member_type AS member_type , f_cdnm('TdmCnclMemberType', tdm22_member_type, tdm20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS member_type_name , tdm22_start_date AS start_date , tdm22_end_date AS end_date FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm22_role_id = tdm20_role_id INNER JOIN tdm05_cncl ON tdm22_cncl_id = tdm05_cncl_id WHERE tdm22_cncl_id = #{cnclId} AND tdm05_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8", tdm22_start_date

SELECT tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id AS role_relate_cncl_id , tdm22_role_id AS role_id , tdm22_cncl_id AS cncl_id , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm22_member_type AS member_type , f_cdnm('TdmCnclMemberType', tdm22_member_type, tdm05_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS member_type_name , tdm22_start_date AS start_date , tdm22_end_date AS end_date FROM tdm22_role_relate_cncl INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm22_role_id = tdm20_role_id INNER JOIN tdm05_cncl ON tdm22_cncl_id = tdm05_cncl_id WHERE tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id = #{roleRelateCnclId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm22_role_relate_cncl ( tdm22_role_relate_cncl_id, tdm22_role_id, tdm22_cncl_id, tdm22_member_type, tdm22_start_date, tdm22_end_date ) VALUES ( #{roleRelateCnclId}, #{row.roleId}, #{row.cnclId}, #{row.memberType}, #{row.startDate}, #{row.endDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT tdm20_role_id AS role_id , tdm20_role_nm AS role_name , tdm20_role_type_nm AS role_type_name , tdm20_role_type_etc_nm AS role_type_etc_name , tdm20_overview AS overview , tdm20_start_date AS start_date , tdm20_end_date AS end_date FROM ( SELECT a.* , f_cdnm('TdmRoleType', tdm20_role_type, tdm20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS tdm20_role_type_nm FROM tdm20_role a WHERE tdm20_company_id = #{companyId} AND CAST(#{baseDate} AS date) BETWEEN tdm20_start_date AND COALESCE(tdm20_end_date, TO_DATE('29991231','yyyyMMdd')) ) t WHERE CONCAT(tdm20_role_nm, tdm20_role_type_nm, tdm20_overview) ILIKE #{searchText} ORDER BY tdm20_role_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm20_role_type , tdm20_role_type_etc_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , tdm20_start_date
